title: Decal colours and materials

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Choose color together with substrate and service life because a physical mark must remain recognizable after installation.
strategic_value: Appropriate decal materials can keep Helsinki signage and vehicles consistent over their intended lifespan.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section lists decal uses and three manufacturers, explains surface/durability choices and shows icon decals on a playpark facade.
practical_value: Select decal stock by surface shape, indoor/outdoor location and required color-fastness duration.

content_islands.name: Use and material guidance
content_islands.spec: List windows, signs, boards and vehicles before manufacturer and durability notes.

content_islands.name: Facade application
content_islands.spec: Show the service-icon decals on the building with their caption.

ingredient.name: Colored decals
ingredient.role: Carry city information onto physical surfaces.
ingredient.application: Use specified manufacturer definitions and choose stock for curved/straight surfaces, indoor/outdoor exposure and intended service life.
ingredient.scope: The section names Avery, 3M and Oracal; it does not claim their materials are interchangeable.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says desired color-fastness duration must be considered when selecting decals.
reference_purposes.Application: The facade photograph shows decals identifying available playpark services.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Material selection must take the desired duration of color fastness into account.
